field.imageSubjectHint: Automatically recognize images after collection, using the saved provider above.
field.maxNotesCountHint: Target initially accepted posts per keyword pair. Jev now accepts previous review candidates and counts them toward the target; you make the final manual decision. Comments count separately. Exhausted results or service failures may leave fewer.
field.maxNotesLimitHint: This platform processes at most this many search results per keyword pair; fewer may be saved after filtering or detail errors.
field.specifiedIdsHint: Enter post or video ID/URL, one per line or comma-separated
field.creatorIdsHint: Enter creator ID/URL, one per line or comma-separated
field.semanticFilterHint: Weibo checks the body first, then checks comments in batches if needed. Initial acceptance stops additional semantic judgments; when comment capture is enabled, comments are still saved up to the per-post limit for browsing and export. Previous review candidates and unresolved budget-limited candidates are retained for your final manual review.
field.commentBudgetHint: Maximum top-level comments to capture and save per post; default 50. Body matches still capture comments without additional Jev judgments after acceptance. Available counts depend on the original post, deleted comments and API limits. Larger limits can take longer.
field.commentBudgetRange: Set 1–10000 comments. Jev initially accepts unresolved budget-limited candidates for your final manual review.
field.commentBudgetInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.
field.semanticUnsupported: Available for Weibo and Xiaohongshu search. Switch platform to enable it.
field.semanticLocalHint: Runs Qwen3.5-4B Q4 from this project's models directory. No API key needed. The first request waits for model loading.
field.semanticApiKeyHint: Held on this page temporarily; not written to local storage or files. Leave empty to use the backend TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

semanticKeyCheckResult.usable: API works: Jev successfully handled a test request.
semanticKeyCheckResult.missing_key: No API key is available. Enter one above.
semanticKeyCheckResult.authentication_rejected: Authentication rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check the key and model access.
semanticKeyCheckResult.billing_or_rate_limit: Billing or rate limit (HTTP {{status}}). The key may still be valid.
semanticKeyCheckResult.provider_error: TypeSafe returned an error (HTTP {{status}}). The key may still be valid; try again later.
semanticKeyCheckResult.request_rejected: Request rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check the model and account configuration.
semanticKeyCheckResult.timeout: Request timed out. Key validity is unknown; try again later.
semanticKeyCheckResult.network_error: Network connection failed. Key validity is unknown.
semanticKeyCheckResult.invalid_response: Unexpected API response. Key validity is unknown.
semanticKeyCheckResult.backend_unreachable: Local backend request failed. Check that the service has restarted and is reachable.

keywordGroupPlaceholder.first: Enter cute, adorable… then press Enter
keywordGroupPlaceholder.second: Enter park, square… then press Enter

field.keywordGroupsHint: Press Enter or import TXT for each group (e.g. cute,adorable). Separate terms with commas or newlines. Imports append unique tags; both groups are paired for sequential searches.

importTxtErrors.size: TXT files must be 1 MB or smaller. Split the file and retry.
importTxtErrors.format: Could not decode the text. Save it as UTF-8 TXT and retry.
importTxtErrors.empty: No keywords found. Separate terms with commas and import again.
importTxtErrors.limit: Use at most 1000 terms per group and 10000 search combinations. Split this task.
importTxtErrors.read: Could not read the file. Select it again.

field.combinationCount_one: {{count}} search combination ready. Searches run in order.

field.keywordGroupsRequired: Add at least one tag to both Keywords 1 and Keywords 2.
field.keywordDraftPending: Some keywords are not added yet. Press Enter to add tags, or clear the input before starting.
field.excelOnlyHint: Only Excel is offered. New tasks use Excel; existing data and running tasks are unchanged.
field.searchKeywords: Search keywords (one search per line; separate terms with spaces; scroll for more)

searchErrors.empty: Enter at least one search row.

jevProxy.scope: Only Jev API requests use this proxy. Weibo collection and SiliconFlow connect directly.

jevProxy.unsaved: Save your changes before selecting a node or testing.
jevProxy.regionRejected: Jev rejected this node (HTTP 451). Choose a node in a supported region and retry.

errors.node_not_found: This node is no longer available. Update the subscription and select again.
errors.proxy_not_ready: The proxy is not ready. Please retry shortly.
